    def find_closest_target(targets):

        if dx != 0:
            move_x = (1 if dx > 0 else -1)
        elif dy != 0:
            move_y = (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        return [move_x, move_y]
    
    # 4. Evasion tactic (move away from enemies or threats)
    if evasion_targets:
        # move in opposite direction of closest threat
        dx, dy = find_closest_target(evasion_targets)

    # Default to no movement

    obstacles = set(tuple(pos) for pos in observation.get('obstacles', []))

            step_y = 0

            step_y = 1 if dy > 0 else -1

        return step_x, step_y
